subtitles.en: On this episode of In the Know, we talk about the crazy employment report.
subtitles.zh: 本期《In the Know》，我们来聊聊那份疯狂的就业报告。

subtitles.en: You'd think we're in recession, and it probably is making people nervous.
subtitles.zh: 你会觉得我们正处于衰退，这很可能让人紧张。

subtitles.en: Is AI going to destroy jobs?
Greetings, everyone. This is Cathy Wood. This is Employment Thursday, not Friday.
subtitles.zh: 大家好，我是Cathy Wood。今天是就业星期四，不是星期五。

subtitles.en: We're going into July 4th weekend. I wish you all a very happy July 4th, our 250th birthday. Very exciting.
subtitles.zh: 我们即将迎来七月四日周末。祝大家七月四日快乐，我们的250岁生日，非常激动人心。

subtitles.en: And maybe not so exciting are all of the charts that I'm going to present.
subtitles.zh: 也许不那么激动人心的是我将展示的所有图表。

subtitles.en: There was a weird employment report today, and when I say weird, I'll put it in context when
subtitles.zh: 今天的就业报告很奇怪，我说奇怪，当你看到图表时就会明白。

subtitles.en: you see the charts. But when you look at these charts, you'd think that we were in a recession.
subtitles.zh: 但看这些图表，你会觉得我们正处于衰退。

subtitles.en: I am so happy that Kevin Worsh is now at the Fed, and that one of his task forces
subtitles.zh: 我很高兴Kevin Worsh现在在美联储，他的一个工作组将研究政府数据及其来源。

subtitles.en: is going to look at government data, how it's derived, and probably bring in more private data,
subtitles.zh: 并可能引入更多私人数据。

subtitles.en: which I think will be very helpful. I think these government statistics have become very distorted. So we'll do a lot around that, and we'll also be looking at inflation,
subtitles.zh: 我认为这会很有帮助。政府统计数据已经严重失真。我们会围绕这一点做很多工作，同时也会关注通胀，

subtitles.en: and trying to figure out where it's going. I just got back from a trip throughout Asia and Europe, and the fear of inflation and higher interest rates was palpable. Now, I think one of the
subtitles.zh: 并试图判断其走向。我刚从亚洲和欧洲出差回来，那里对通胀和利率上升的担忧非常明显。我认为

subtitles.en: reasons for that is currencies elsewhere in the world have been going down, or in many places.
subtitles.zh: 原因之一是世界其他地区的货币在贬值，或者很多地方都是如此。
